'''Rokirex''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Krex]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Despite being widely considered the Krex's native world, their ancient mythology referred to their ancestors as [[Spacer/Legends|travelers]], and it was theorized that the Krex were descendants of some [[Chistori]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] who settled on Rokirex.<ref name="TOR" />
